source: GET https://api.together.ai/v2/supported-models (public catalog of models deployable on Together dedicated endpoints), read 2026-09-28
note: The only certified deployment profile for Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is BF16 on 4x NVIDIA H100 (TP4). The serverless model used in the open-weight condition, meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo, is Together's FP8 build; the v1 hardware listing on 2026-09-28 quoted 4x_nvidia_h100_80gb_sxm at 36 cents/min and the v2 instance-type table quotes 4xnvidia-h100-80gb at 1596 cents/hour.

entry.name: meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
entry.description: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is a Meta open model for chat, reasoning, coding, and general-purpose text generation.
